headline: Public hearing on a water special assessment district agreement, and a $700,000 fire truck fund withdrawal for two fire engines.
summary: A three-year renewal of the Pelham emergency dispatch contract and proposed Recreation Ordinance language are also on the agenda. Department budget discussions and a Greater Derry Community Health Services update are listed too.
items: Water special assessment district agreement, public hearing
Greater Derry Community Health Services program update
Fire truck reserve withdrawal up to $700,000
item_action_words: Receive an update from Greater Derry Community Health Services (CHS)
Discuss and approve a capital reserve withdrawal request
Approve the Intermunicipal Agreement for Pelham Dispatch Services.
Discuss and review the proposed Recreation Ordinance language.

Londonderry Town Council Meeting / Budget Workshop
Monday, November 30, 2026, 6 p.m., Moose Hill Council Chambers
CALL TO ORDER
PUBLIC COMMENT
BOARD APPOINTMENTS & REAPPOINTMENTS
None
PUBLIC HEARING
Receive public input, discuss, and approve the Memorandum of Understanding for a Water Special Assessment 
District
a. Presentation: Administrative Services Director Kirsten Hildonen
b. Opening of the public hearing
c. Questions & comments by the public
l Residents who are unable to attend the public hearing may submit written comments to the 
Town Council by email using the link: SUBMIT PUBLIC COMMENT ONLINE
d. Closing of the public hearing
e. Council deliberation & action
1. 2026-11-30 WSAD COVER SHEET.PDF
2. 2026-11-30 WSAD IMPROVEMENT PLAN.PDF
3. 2026-11-30 EXHIBIT A MAP.PDF
4. 2026-11-30 EXHIBIT B LIST OF PROPERTIES IN THE DISTRICT.PDF
5. 2026-11-30 WSAD MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING.PDF
NEW BUSINESS
Receive an update from Greater Derry Community Health Services (CHS) regarding its programs and services.
A representative from CHS will provide an overview of the programs, resources, and assistance available to 
Londonderry residents, including the organization's role in supporting the Town's human services needs.
2026-11-30 COMMUNITY HEALTH SERVICES INFORMATION.PDF
Budget Workshop – Department budgets for discussion
Budget documents and related information are available on the Town's Budget webpage.
a. Fire Department 
b. Information Technology
c. Public Works / General Government
d. Sewer
e. Solid Waste
f. Town Manager
l Legal
l General Assistance
l Conservation
l Town Council
l Cultural Affairs
2026-11-30 NHMA 2027 LETTER.PDF
Discuss and approve a capital reserve withdrawal request from the Fire Truck Capital Reserve Fund for up to a total 
of $700,000. 
(Finance Director Justin Campo)
The Fire department is looking to utilize up to $700,000 from the Fire Truck Capital Reserve Fund to be put towards the 
purchase of two new fire engines and to decrease the amount needed to be financed for the two incoming new engines.  
1. 2026-11-30 COVER SHEET_FIRE TRUCK CRF WITHDRAWAL REQUEST.PDF
2. FIRE - ENGINE-PUMPER BID 830.PDF
3. FIRE - ENGINE-PUMPER BID 879.PDF
4. 2026-20 - FIRE TRUCK CRF (FIRE TRUCKS).PDF
OLD BUSINESS
Approve the Intermunicipal Agreement for Pelham Dispatch Services.
(Fire Chief James Young)
The Town of Londonderry is currently contracted by the Town of Pelham to provide emergency dispatch services. The 
current contract expires on January 1, 2027. The Fire Department is requesting that the Council approve a renewal of the 
contract for three years.
1. 2026-11-30 COVER SHEET _PELHAM DISPATCH CONTRACT.PDF
2. PELHAM FIRE DISPATCH CONTRACT FY28 TO FY30.PDF
Discuss and review the proposed Recreation Ordinance language. 
1. 2026-11-16 COVER SHEET_RECREATION ORDINANCES.PDF
2. 2026-11-16 CHAPTER 130 PARKS AND RECREATION FACILITIES.PDF
3. 2026-11-16 CHAPTER XXII TOWN COMMON WITH REDLINES.PDF
4. 2026-11-16 CHAPTER XXIII PARKS WITH REDLINES.PDF
5. 2026-11-16 CHAPTER XXVIII SANCTIONING WITH REDLINES.PDF
6. ORDINANCE 2026-17 AMEND ADMIN CODE RECREATION ORDINANCE.PDF
APPROVAL OF CONSENT ITEMS
Dec 2026 Tax Warrant
2026P02 TAX BILL.PDF
Supplemental Tax Warrant
SUPPLEMENTAL BILL P02 2026_REDACTED.PDF
OTHER BUSINESS
Liaison Reports
Town Manager Report
PUBLIC COMMENT
NON-PUBLIC SESSION
ADJOURNMENT
MEETING SCHEDULE

l Public Hearing: Receive public input, discuss and consider approving the proposed amendments to 
Recreation ordinances

December 14, 2026; Moose Hill Council Chambers; 7 p.m. 
l Public Hearing: Receive public input, discuss and act upon fiscal year 2028 budget and bond (if necessary) 
l Approval of MOA template for field usage Town sports leagues & organizations w/associated process  
l Presentation on updated facility use policy for Town -owned public & recreational facilities
